workflow: This infographic summarizes the legal proceedings surrounding Microsoft's antitrust lawsuit. In 1998, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a lawsuit against Microsoft alleging that the company had abused its monopoly in the computer operating system market. The case included numerous appeals to various courts, resulting in Microsoft being found guilty and ordered to be broken up into two separate companies by 2000.
